A 62 year old and a 24 year old met up for drinks after work and both immediately started complaining about their stressful days. The 62 year old had a hard time because they had to deal with a lot of really angry customers calling to complain, and the other one had a hard day because their product release was delayed. Who works in customer service?
A. The 62 year old
B. Cannot be determined
C. The 24 year old
